programme.title: Lalaki Chunariya Odh Ke
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of melodious devotional songs performed by talented musicians is played in quick succession.

programme.title: Gumrah
programme.desc: Meena, who lives with her retired and widowed father in rural Nainital, is visited by her sister, her husband and her two children. Meena speaks of her love for Rajendra, a painter and singer, and Kamla, her sister, approves of her choice. However, before Meena can make a move, Kamla passes away leaving her children in the hands of Meena.

programme.title: Chhoti Si Baat
programme.desc: Plot. Chhoti Si Baat is a romantic comedy about a painfully shy young man Arun Pradeep (Amol Palekar), who lacks self-confidence and fails to stand up for his convictions, in the process letting all and sundry walk all over him.

programme.title: Khuddar
programme.desc: Hari is forced to marry Seema, who dislikes his stepbrothers, Govind and Rajesh. When he goes to Mumbai, she displaces them to become beggars. However, destiny reunites them with Hari in a courtroom.

programme.title: Vreau să fiu al tău
programme.desc: Rămas orfan la o vârstă foarte fragedă, un tânăr este luat de un gangster și antrenat să accepte crima ca fiind cariera sa. Într-o zi, el dă peste un copil abandonat și decide să îl adopte. Acest lucru îi schimbă viața, iar el decide să se îndrepte.

programme.title: Iubirea prințesei Jodhaa
programme.desc: O poveste de dragoste din secolul 16 despre căsătoria aranjată dintre un împărat mongol şi o prinţesă din Rajput, pe nume Jodha, se transformă în dragoste reală.

programme.title: In transa
programme.desc: Un speaker motivațional deziluzionat acceptă să devină predicator pentru o corporație aflată în căutarea unui nou suflu spiritual. Însă apariția sa în direct la TV atrage atenția publicului și ridică semne de întrebare asupra sincerității sale...

programme.title: Fratia strazii
programme.desc: Patru prieteni, prinși în lumea interlopă, își pun în pericol viețile personale, ajungând într-un punct fără întoarcere.

programme.title: Hello Hum Lallann Bol Rahe Hain
programme.desc: Un paznic organizează căsătoria femeii pe care o iubește cu alt bărbat.

programme.title: Avere si destin
programme.desc: Kashinath și Imli, iubiți din copilărie, văd cum viața lor se complică când apare Anjali. Dragoste, boală și sacrificii le vor testa relația și devotamentul.

programme.title: Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna
programme.desc: Dev locuieste in SUA si e fotbalist. E insurat cu Ryna. Dev iai rupe piciorul, dezvolta un handicap si devine dependent de Ryna. Acasa, singur, incepe sa-si faca de lucru, iar apoi incepe s-o suspecteze pe Ryna ca ar avea o aventura cu un alt barbat.

programme.title: Ghulam-E-Musthafa
programme.desc: Un gangster renunță la viața criminală după ce iubita lui este ucisă de rivali, dar șeful său îl forțează să revină pentru o ultimă misiune.

programme.title: Bodyguardul
programme.desc: Bodyguard este un film indian romantic şi de acţiune. Este cel de-al treilea remake al filmului Bodyguard. În rolurile principale îi putem vedea pe Salman Khan şi Kareena Kapoor.

programme.title: Prieteni
programme.desc: Trei bărbați aproape identici devin prieteni buni după ce se cunosc printr-o aplicație online de căutare a sosiei. Totul este distractiv până când unul dintre ei se dovedește a fi un fugar notoriu.

programme.title: Supraviețuitoarea
programme.desc: O tânără se mută în Mumbai după ce își pierde părinții, iar orașul său este distrus în urma conflictelor religioase. Ca să supraviețuiască se angajează în calitate de dansatoare într-un bar.

programme.title: Ce se intampla, draga mea?
programme.desc: O comedie plină de încurcături care străbate zonele rurale din Haryana, dezvăluind relații haotice, situații nebunești și excentricități în rândul familiei, prietenilor, îndrăgostiților și chiar al polițiștilor!

programme.title: Maior la datorie
programme.desc: Filmul este inspirat din viața maiorului Sandeep Unnikrishnan, eroul care a luptat cu curaj în timpul atacurilor teroriste din Mumbai, în noiembrie 2008. O poveste despre sacrificiu, onoare și datoria dusă până la capăt.

programme.title: Pamantul - 1947
programme.desc: În Lahore, 1947, înaintea separării Indiei de Pakistan, un grup de prieteni cu credințe diferite își petrec zilele împreună. După separare, tensiunile cresc, iar tânăra Lenny, alături de dadaca ei Shanta, asistă la destrămarea armoniei din jurul lor.

programme.title: Baazaar
programme.desc: După ce se mută la Mumbai, un tânăr ambițios devine trader de acțiuni pentru un om de afaceri cunoscut pentru activitățile sale dubioase.

programme.title: Steaua de mare
programme.desc: O călătorie frumoasă prin adâncurile lumii subacvatice, în timp ce suntem martorii unei povești captivante despre durere și vindecare care se desfășoară sub ochii noștri.

programme.title: Cantec nevazut
programme.desc: O serie de evenimente misterioase îi schimbă viața unui pianist orb, care acum trebuie să raporteze o crimă despre care, teoretic, nu ar trebui să știe nimic.

programme.title: Ek Anjaan Rishtey Ka Guilt
programme.desc: Saru este căsătorită cu Pratap, ofițer de poliție, însă problemele de intimitate dintre ei creează o ruptură în mariaj. Saru găsește sprijin în Sunil, prietenul din copilărie al soțului ei. Apropierea dintre ei se transformă treptat într-o relație...

programme.title: Sukhee
programme.desc: Spre disperarea soțului ei, o gospodină din clasa de mijloc, cunoscută pentru atitudinea ei rebelă din liceu, decide să participe la reuniunea de clasă.

programme.title: Naqaab
programme.desc: Indragostita de un baiat bogat, Sofia, o tanara din clasa d mijloc, incepe sa il indrageasca pe Vicky...

programme.title: Seful
programme.desc: Boss ia asupra sa vina pentru o crimă comisă din greșeală de tatăl său. După închisoare, devine un gangster temut, dar viața lui ia o turnură periculoasă când un polițist corupt și un politician îi cer să ucidă, punându-l într-o dilemă cumplită.

programme.title: Iubirea prințesei Jodhaa
programme.desc: O poveste de dragoste din secolul 16 despre căsătoria aranjată dintre un împărat mongol şi o prinţesă din Rajput, pe nume Jodha, se transformă în dragoste reală.

programme.title: Trăiește clipa
programme.desc: Desi o iubeste nespus de mult, Aman incearca sa o impinga in bratele prietenului ei cel mai bun, Rohit. Reuseste, iar cand Naina era deja fericita de noua schimbare, afla ca Aman e pe moarte si ca de fapt el s-a sacrificat pentru ea.

programme.title: Auzaar
programme.desc: Yash și Suraj, prieteni buni, urmează drumuri diferite: Yash preia afacerea tatălui său mafiot, iar Suraj devine ofițer CBI. Când tatăl lui Yash este atacat, acesta jură răzbunare, iar Suraj începe o anchetă care le va testa prietenia.

programme.title: Houdini's Last Secrets
programme.sub-title: The life of Harry Houdini remains as much of a mystery as his death. A team of magicians and scientists try to unlock the secrets he took with him to the grave
programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? Helping piece together clues and testing out his most daring stunts are Houdini's grand-nephew George Hardeen, magician and daredevil Lee Terbosic, and master stunt builder Steve Wolf.

programme.title: The Bad Skin Clinic
programme.sub-title: Dr. Emma Craythorne helps people with embarrassing conditions in their private parts. Sarah arrives with a 'boo-boo on her woo-hoo'
programme.desc: Dr Emma Craythorne and her team of experts are on a mission to solve complex skin conditions. They help people whose lives have been impeded by devastating disorders, and these patients hope Emma and her team have the solution.

programme.title: Bering Sea Gold
programme.sub-title: Shawn has a bold plan to rebuild the Myrtle Irene. Zeke tests out his unique sailboat dredge, and Vernon exams his claim with an underwater drone
programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. This series, from the creators of the Emmy-winning \"Deadliest Catch,\" follows four gold dredges and their eccentric and driven crews who risk their lives to find as much gold as possible before winter sets in and it's too dangerous to dive. The custom-built rigs, some barely seaworthy, include an 80-foot barge run by the most successful gold dredger in Nome, Alaska, and a modified skiff that seats only two people.

credits.actor: Mike Rowe,Shawn Pomrenke,Emily Riedel,Kris Kelly,Vernon Adkison,Andy Kelly,Brad Kelly,Zeke Tenhoff,Cody Moen,Steve Riedel,Dave Young,Steve Pomrenke,George Young,Ken Kerr,Chris Thornton,Joel Pellegrino,Thom Beers

programme.title: You Have Been Warned
programme.sub-title: The smartest and bravest people use science to take their skills to the next level, from using a vacuum cleaner as a didgeridoo to creating a mechanised super suit
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

credits.actor: Alistair Linsell,Timothy Dabado,Helen Arney,Debbie Berebichez,Hakeem Oluseyi,Adam Ruben

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.sub-title: The manufacturing of Skippy peanut butter, aubergine Parmesan, Wonderful pistachios and chocolate bars filled with tortilla chips and candy
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.sub-title: Zak and the crew continue their terrifying investigation of historic Pendleton, Oregon. A tip from a local sends the team to an unexplored section of the town's mysterious tunnel system that may bring more shameful secrets - and a curse - to light
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Live: SportsCenter
programme.desc: The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on "SportsCenter," ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new midnight show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live "SportsCenter" morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms.

programme.title: Live: Inside the NBA
programme.desc: This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season.

programme.title: Live: NBA Courtside
programme.desc: An insight into upcoming National Basketball Association matches, highlighting the players to watch and the top team news.

programme.title: Live: NBA Basketball
programme.desc: The Minnesota Timberwolves visit the Miami Heat at Kaseya Center in Miami, Florida. Minnesota won 122-94 in Jan 2026 in their latest meeting, earning its second win in four days. The Northwest Division Timberwolves face the Southeast Division Heat.

programme.title: Live: NBA Basketball
programme.desc: The Golden State Warriors visit the Los Angeles Lakers at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. The Lakers won 119-103 on April 9, completing a 3-1 season-series win over the Golden State. The Pacific Division rivals meet again in the Western Conference.

programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Eagle Queen of the Skies
programme.desc: Eagles are top predators who battle fiercely for survival and work hard to raise their young. There are 60 members of the eagle clan, all united by their acute eyesight, powerful wings, sharp talons and hooked beaks. To explore the world of the eagle we follow one individual from hatching to leaving the nest and setting up a home. Her fight for survival reveals what it takes to become a queen of the sky.

programme.title: Anaconda Wanted
programme.desc: Anacondas have fired people's imagination since time immemorial. Hardly any other animal is so feared and yet at the same time so revered as the biggest snake in the world.

programme.title: Sudden Death
programme.desc: The gallery forests of the Serengeti are the realm of a phantom. The shadowy thickets are the domain of a Leopardess.

programme.title: Haunted Huntress
programme.desc: A brook in the Serengeti is the home of a leopardess. The secret queen of the shadows took care of her son and has done a good job so far but the adventure continues.

programme.title: Designed for Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler’s mastery of propaganda, and his instinctive skill for effective design, helps win huge popular support for the Nazi party, a vital step in its march towards total power.

programme.title: Hitler's Highways
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler promises to make Germany great again with his ambitious plans to create 22,000 kms of motorway and build one and half million “People’s Cars” every year.

programme.title: The Industry of War
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler is determined to rebuild Germany’s military strength after its humiliating defeat in the First World War by stealing raw materials from abroad.

programme.title: A Culture of Control
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler is determined to change the way German people think and feel by creating a new, Nazi form of art and culture. He takes control of all forms of media to spread Nazi propaganda.

programme.title: Himmler's Empire of Terror
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler’s bid for power depends on his most loyal and violent supporters, the SS. They use intimidation, detention, terror and even murder to defeat all the Nazis political enemies.

programme.title: Retreat from Reality
programme.desc: Hitler uses technology and terror to keep Germans fighting to the bitter end.

programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programme.title: Rising Sun
programme.desc: After briefly setting the scene, Episode One delves into the early years of Emperor Hirohito’s reign.

programme.title: For the Sake of the Country
programme.desc: Episode Two explores the military’s tightening control over Japanese society, the disbanding of labour unions and influences upon education.

programme.title: The Sun that Shines
programme.desc: Japan seized more than 2,500,000 km² of land in Southeast Asia and almost the entire western half of the Pacific.

programme.title: An Extraordinary Measure
programme.desc: On the day that Nagasaki was bombed, the Trans Baikal and 2nd Far East Fronts of the Red Army invaded Manchuria, the 1st Far East Front moved from Vladivostok.

programme.title: Countdown to Surrender: The End
programme.desc: The final act of the Second World War is its most costly episode. More than one million German soldiers die in 1945 alone.

programme.title: The Seeds of Violence 1918-1922
programme.desc: Hatred and the desire for revenge smoldered in the minds of many Germans after the First World War. Many Germans believe that the Jews are the cause of all kinds of problems.

programme.title: Deceit and Delusion 1923-1928
programme.desc: Hitler and his movement seem to be eliminated after his failed putsch on November 9, 1923, the movement is banned, the self-proclaimed leaders are imprisoned.

programme.title: Democracy without Democrats 1929-1933
programme.desc: In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.

programme.title: The Racial State 1933-1934
programme.desc: After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.

programme.title: Hidden in Plain Sight 1935-1938
programme.desc: In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.

programme.title: Up in Flames 1936-1940
programme.desc: At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.

programme.title: The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis
programme.desc: "The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis" presents documents and footage proving the royal family’s and leading British aristocrats’ sympathy for National Socialism.

programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programme.title: Concrete Against Bombs
programme.desc: The first programme features four bunkers built before World War Two. We begin with the legendary Franzensfeste in today’s northern Italy, a fortress that was never besieged.

programme.title: Facing Nuclear Annihilation
programme.desc: The second programme features shelters in the nuclear era in Lithuania, Germany and Albania.

programme.title: What if Hitler Had Won the War
programme.desc: The documentary addresses the counterfactual question of a Nazi victory in the Second World War and is asking at the same time how history would have evolved without Hitler.

programme.title: Donnie Darko
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: A team of former Soviet superheroes, assembled during the Cold War to combat a dangerous scientist, is dispatched against destructive robots.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story
programme.desc: In his small North Carolina hometown, Ron Clark (Matthew Perry) leads a comfortable life as a successful elementary school teacher, earning the respect of the community. However, he knows there are students elsewhere who need him more. Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. Clark makes it his mission to turn around the worst students, even though he knows his job is on the line.

programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
programme.sub-title: A Hindu priest from Tirumala explains the chapters from Bhagavata Purana to the devotees of Lord Krishna in a detailed manner
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அம்மன் கோவில்கள்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and cultural significance of various temples and shrines dedicated to Goddess Amman
programme.desc: தேவி அம்மனுக்கான பல்வேறு கோவில்கள் மற்றும் சன்னதிகளின் மத மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவத்தை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: கும்பாபிஷேகம்

programme.title: ஆர்ஜேஆர் - ஹெர்பல் ஸ்லாட்

And, for the public, finally the occasion to discover live these new compositions, mixing rock, folk and electro pop. With reggae vibrations that can rub shoulders with house elements, Milky Chance has one of the most singular sounds. programme.title: विश्वनाथ
programme.sub-title: Vishwanath, an honest lawyer, is framed and imprisoned due to a gangster. After his release, he sets out to seek revenge and ends up becoming a criminal
programme.desc: एक ईमानदार वकील, विश्वनाथ को एक गैंगस्टर की वजह से फंसाया जाता है और जेल भेजा जाता है। अपनी रिहाई के बाद, वह बदला लेने का निश्चय करता है और अंततः अपराधी बन जाता है।.

credits.actor: Shatrughan Sinha,Reena Roy,Bharat Bhushan,Rita Bhaduri,Sulochana Latkar,Parikshit Sahni,Premnath,Sudhir,Pran,Madan Puri,Satyendra Kapoor,Iftikhar

programme.title: दीवाना तेरे नाम का
programme.sub-title: Friends Shankar and Shambhu share a lot in common and also end up falling in love with the same girl. However, when the girl loves Shankar, Shambhu parts ways with him and joins his rival
programme.desc: दोस्त, शंकर और शंभू में बहुत कुछ समान है और उन्हें एक ही लड़की से प्यार होता है। जब लड़की शंकर से प्यार करती है, तो शंभू उससे दोस्ती तोड़ देता है और विरोधी के साथ शामिल होता है।.

credits.actor: Mithun Chakraborty,Vijayata Pandit,Danny Denzongpa,Jagdeep,Seema Deo,Kamal Kapoor,Yunus Parvez,Sharat Saxena,Jugal Kishore

programme.title: स्वर्ग से सुंदर
programme.sub-title: Two brothers struggle to keep their family together as external forces like the younger brother's father-in-law try to break them apart
programme.desc: छोटे भाई के ससुर जैसी बाहरी ताकतें उन्हें तोड़ने की कोशिश करती हैं तो दो भाई अपने परिवार को एकजुट रखने के लिए संघर्ष करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Jeetendra,Jayapradha,Mithun Chakraborty,Padmini Kolhapure,Asrani,Aruna Irani,Prem Chopra,Kader Khan,Shoma Anand,Satyendra Kapoor

programme.title: क्या यही प्यार है
programme.sub-title: Rahul falls in love with Sandhya, a fellow college student, but realises that she does not reciprocate his feelings. Undeterred by her rejection, he still pursues her but pays a huge price for it
programme.desc: बेहद आक्रामक और अपमानजनक पुलिस अधिकारी, संध्या के पिता, राहुल को गिरफ़्तार कराते है जो संध्या से एकतरफा प्यार करता है। उसका भाई उसकी जमानत कराता है लेकिन राहुल, वहीं दोहराने से बड़ी कीमत चुकाता है।.

credits.actor: Aftab Shivdasani,Ameesha Patel,Jackie Shroff,Ashish Vidyarthi,Neena Kulkarni,Anupama Verma,Vrajesh Hirjee,Sarfaraz Khan

programme.title: मैं तुलसी तेरे आंगन की
programme.sub-title: A wife embraces her husband's illegitimate son as her own in honour of the other woman's memory. However, as time progresses, this starts to seem like a big mistake
programme.desc: संजुक्ता अपने पति के नाजायज बेटे, अजय की परवरिश अपने बेटे, प्रताप के साथ करती है। वह अजय को अपनी संपत्ति के सभी आधिकारिक मामलों को संभालने देती है, इस वजह से प्रताप क्रोधित होता है।.

credits.actor: Nutan,Vinod Khanna,Vijay Anand,Asha Parekh,Debu Mukherjee,Neeta Mehta,Trilok Kapoor,Master Bhagwan,Kumari Naaz,Goga Kapoor,C.S. Dubey,Asit Kumar Sen

programme.title: भाभी
programme.sub-title: A woman finds out her husband only married her to get revenge. However, she finds solace in her brother-in-law who helps her escape the abusive household
programme.desc: एक महिला को उसके पति के सिर्फ बदले के लिए उससे शादी करने का पता चलता है। हालाँकि, उसे अपने देवर से सांत्वना मिलती है जो उसे इस घर से निकलने में मदद करता है।.

credits.actor: Bhanupriya (Sita/Kamini),Govinda (Amar/Nakadram),Juhi Chawla (Asha),Gulshan Grover (Rakesh),Anand Balraj (Prakash),Ajit Vachani (Ghanshyamdas),Shashi Puri (Inspector Sudhir),Ram Mohan (Ramdas)

programme.title: लॉरी
programme.sub-title: Geeta is expecting a baby but tragedy strikes and she loses her child. When she finds a little boy, she adopts him as her own, but the boy's family accuses her of kidnapping
programme.desc: गीता गर्भवती होती है पर एक घटना के कारण वह अपना बच्चा खो देती है। जब उसे एक छोटा बच्चा मिलता है तब वह उसे अपना लेती है, लेकिन बच्चे का परिवार उस पर अपहरण का आरोप लगाता है।.

credits.actor: Farooq Sheikh,Naseeruddin Shah,Shabana Azmi,Swaroop Sampat,Rohini Hattangadi,Madan Puri,Shaukat Azmi,Paresh Rawal,Yunus Parvez,Sulabha Deshpande,Kiran Vairale

programme.title: दिल का रिश्ता
programme.sub-title: Jai, a wealthy businessman in love with Tia, accidentally kills her husband in a car crash. After the accident Tia loses her memory and falls for Jai, who struggles with guilt
programme.desc: टिया से प्यार करने वाला एक अमीर व्यापारी जय, गलती से एक कार दुर्घटना में उसके पति को मार देता है। दुर्घटना के बाद टिया की याददाश्त खो जाती है और जय से प्यार करने लगती है, जो अपराधबोध से जूझता है।.

credits.actor: Aishwarya Rai (Tia Sharma),Arjun Rampal (Jai Mehta),Priyanshu Chatterjee (Raj),Raakhee (Mrinalini Sharma),Isha Koppikar (Anita),Paresh Rawal (Harshavardhan Mehta),Tiku Talsania (Swamy),Hitanshu Lodhia (Anshu)

programme.title: एंजल
programme.sub-title: Abhay returns from prison after running over a man and falls for the victim's daughter. However, when her brother sees them in a compromising position, he accuses Abhay of assaulting her
programme.desc: एक आदमी को गाड़ी के नीचे कुचलने के बाद, अभय रिहा हो जाता है और उसकी मनोरोगी बेटी से प्यार करने लगता है। हालांकि, अभय के साथ सोनल को देखने पर, सोनल का भाई, अभय पर बलात्कार का आरोप लगा देता है।.

credits.actor: Aruna Irani,Manoj Joshi,Kishori Shahane,Sumit Arora,Nilesh Sahay,Madalasa Sarma,Satish Sharma,Sandeep Shetty,Vaishali Thakkar

programme.title: एंजल
programme.sub-title: Abhay returns from prison after running over a man and falls for the victim's daughter. However, when her brother sees them in a compromising position, he accuses Abhay of assaulting her
programme.desc: एक आदमी को गाड़ी के नीचे कुचलने के बाद, अभय रिहा हो जाता है और उसकी मनोरोगी बेटी से प्यार करने लगता है। हालांकि, अभय के साथ सोनल को देखने पर, सोनल का भाई, अभय पर बलात्कार का आरोप लगा देता है।.

programme.title: विनाशक - डेस्ट्रोयर
programme.sub-title: A diligent and determined police officer is tasked with uncovering the truth behind a crooked warden involved in illicit weapon trafficking
programme.desc: एक बहादुर और ईमानदार अधिकारी, अर्जुन को अवैध हथियारों के व्यापार में शामिल एक भ्रष्ट जेलर, लंकेश्वर को बेनकाब करने का काम सौंपा जाता है।.

credits.actor: Sunil Shetty,Raveena Tandon,Danny Denzongpa,Tinnu Anand,Alok Nath,Mohan Joshi,Om Puri

programme.title: एक्सीडेन्ट ऑन हिल रोड
programme.sub-title: Sonam's night of celebration turns into a disaster when her car hits an innocent man. Afraid of being punished for the crime, she decides to hide him but invites trouble in turn
programme.desc: एक कार दुर्घटना में सोनम द्वारा राह चलते आदमी, प्रकाश की हत्या हो जाती है और उसकी लाश को घर लेकर आती है। अपने प्रेमी की मदद से वह उसकी लाश को ठिकाने लगाती है पर कई समस्यायें खड़ी हो जाती हैं।.

credits.actor: Farooq Sheikh,Abhimanyu Singh,Celina Jaitley,Manmeet Singh,Rukhsar Rehman,Shammi,Shobha Khote,Dadhi Raj

programme.title: नया दिन नई रात
programme.sub-title: Sushma escapes from her arranged marriage and embarks on an adventure that changes her life forever. Along the way, she encounters several men, each embodying different aspects of human life
programme.desc: एक युवती, सुषमा शादी से बचने के लिए घर से भाग जाती है। अपने रास्ते में, वह कई लोगों से मिलती है, जो इन्सानों के विभिन्न स्वभाव को प्रस्तुत करते हैं और कठिनाइयों में उसकी मदद करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Sanjeev Kumar (Anand / Swami Rahasyanand / Mr. Sarang / Seth Dhanraj / Sher Singh / Four Other Roles),Jaya Bhaduri,Sunder,Shivraj (Principal Verma),V. Gopal,Johnny Whisky,Dilip Dutt,Polson (Stage Actor)

programme.title: घर घर की कहानी
programme.sub-title: Ram begins to suspect that his wife, Seeta, is having an affair with his brother, Amar. His doubts persist even after Amar gets married, creating problems within his family
programme.desc: राम को अपनी पत्नी पर उसके छोटे भाई अमर के साथ संबंध होने का संदेह है। अमर की उसकी प्रेमिका से शादी हो जाने के बाद भी उसका संदेह बरक़रार रहता है।.

credits.actor: Govinda,Farha Naaz,Rishi Kapoor,Jaya Prada,Kader Khan,Ashok Saraf

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.sub-title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Michael Brecker Band
programme.sub-title: Michael Brecker Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, decorated American saxophonist and composer Michael Brecker and his band played at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Accompanied by bassist Jeff Andrews, drummer Adam Nussbaum, pianist Joey Calderazzo, and guitarist Mike Stern, Brecker displayed his virtuosity in spades.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.sub-title: Hayo Hayta
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Charles Mingus, Jaki Byard, Dannie Richmond & Johnny Coles
programme.sub-title: Charles Mingus And Eric Dolphy live in Liège
programme.desc: Charles Mingus showcases an exceptional concert performed in April 1965 featuring his most celebrated lineup: Jaki Byard (piano), Dannie Richmond (drums), Johnny Coles (trumpet), Clifford Jordan (tenor sax) and the great Eric Dolphy (alto sax, flute and bass clarinet). Recorded within an eight-day span, less than three months before Dolphy's death, the three concerts showcase Mingus's visionary leadership and the band's incredible depth and diversity with unique performances and arrangements of classics including ‘So Long Eric' and the groundbreaking ‘Meditations On Integration'.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas
programme.sub-title: Unstoppable
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris captures the British singer-songwriter at her best: with her crystalline voice she performs soulful melodies full of sincerity. The performance is part of La Havas' 'Blood Tour', a concert tour promoting her second album 'Blood' (2015). She is accompanied by James Wyatt on keys, Adam Prendergast on bass, Giles King Ashong on drums, and Frida Touray on backing vocals.

programme.title: Maceo Parker
programme.sub-title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove', he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result? Overheated concert halls, with enthusiastic audiences that completely surrender themselves to the music's boundless energy.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Buster Williams
programme.sub-title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 1
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: Cliffside beach: Indonesia

programme.title: A Day in the Caribbean 2
programme.desc: A Day in the Caribbean transports viewers miles away from it all, to the gorgeous tropical island of Antigua. Arriving just at dawn, you'll enjoy a stunning golden sunrise and rainbow, followed by a couple hours of beautiful beach scenes as you explore the beautiful resort surroundings. Abundant, vibrant vistas will instantly transform your screen into a window to the glorious Caribbean - with nothing but the pure sounds of nature to accompany it. (Music version coming soon though)

programme.desc: Chef Robert Irvine tries to help failing restaurants make a comeback. Armed with two days and a budget of $10,000, he updates their menus and their fortunes to help them become successful again.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress

programme.desc: The Teletubbies see a little girl and her brother who love salad. They go shopping in a market a market with their grandma to buy some salad to eat.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.sub-title: Making Lanterns
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.sub-title: Colours - Green
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.sub-title: Colours - Blue
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.sub-title: Christening
programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.sub-title: Feeding Sheep in Winter
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.sub-title: Hanukah
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.sub-title: Washing Up
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.sub-title: Number 5
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.sub-title: Christmas Tree
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.sub-title: Making Christmas Cards
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.sub-title: Crackers
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.sub-title: Carol Singing
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

programme.title: Pelli Kani Prasad
programme.desc: A romance grows complex when a disapproving father arranges his daughter Saroj's marriage. However, the groom coincidentally shares the same name as her true love, Prasad.

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: தாமரை

programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: கூண்டுக்கிளி
programme.sub-title: Balasudha's life comes to a halt as she sacrifices her happiness when her family loses all their wealth and properties and is forced to shift into a rental house
programme.desc: பாலசுதவின் குடும்பம் செல்வம் மற்றும் சொத்துக்கள் என அனைத்தையும் இழந்து, வாடகை வீட்டிற்க்கு குடிபெயர வேண்டிய கட்டாயத்திற்கு வரும்போது, அவளோ தன் மகிழ்ச்சியை தியாகம் செய்வது அவளது வாழ்வு குலைகிறது.

programme.title: அலாதின்

programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: அம்மு
programme.sub-title: Anupama, a schoolchild, lives happily with her mother and her elder sister. However, she goes through many problems trying to figure out her father's identity
programme.desc: பள்ளி மாணவியான அனுபமா, தன் தாய் மற்றும் அக்காவுடன் மகிழ்ச்சியாக வாழ்கிறாள். இருப்பினும், தன் தந்தையை பற்றிய உண்மையை கண்டறிய முயற்சிக்கும்போது அவள் பல சிக்கல்களைச் சந்திக்கிறாள்.

credits.actor: Vinaya Prasad,Malavika Wales,Srinish Aravind,Subash Balakrishnan,Baby Keshiya,Preetha Pradeep

programme.title: அலாதின்
programme.desc: Aladdin, a poor thief, discovers a magical lamp containing a Genie. However, soon he realizes that Zafar, an evil sorcerer, also desires the lamp to rule over Baghdad.

credits.actor: Siddharth Nigam,Aamir Dalvi,Smita Bansal,Avneet Kaur,Raashul Tandon

programme.title: Insight With Haslinda Amin
programme.desc: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation.

programme.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa

programme.desc: "The Opening Trade" explores things to know as markets open across Europe analysis that isn't available anywhere else, a break-down of the biggest stories of the day and top guests who have skin in the game.

programme.desc: Genesis is the theme this week, as Robin and Julia head east to investigate a story about biblical tourism. programme.title: Houdini's Last Secrets
programme.sub-title: The life of Harry Houdini remains as much of a mystery as his death. A team of magicians and scientists try to unlock the secrets he took with him to the grave
programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? Helping piece together clues and testing out his most daring stunts are Houdini's grand-nephew George Hardeen, magician and daredevil Lee Terbosic, and master stunt builder Steve Wolf.

programme.title: The Bad Skin Clinic
programme.sub-title: Dr. Emma Craythorne helps people with embarrassing conditions in their private parts. Sarah arrives with a 'boo-boo on her woo-hoo'
programme.desc: Dr Emma Craythorne and her team of experts are on a mission to solve complex skin conditions. They help people whose lives have been impeded by devastating disorders, and these patients hope Emma and her team have the solution.

programme.title: Bering Sea Gold
programme.sub-title: Shawn has a bold plan to rebuild the Myrtle Irene. Zeke tests out his unique sailboat dredge, and Vernon exams his claim with an underwater drone
programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. This series, from the creators of the Emmy-winning \"Deadliest Catch,\" follows four gold dredges and their eccentric and driven crews who risk their lives to find as much gold as possible before winter sets in and it's too dangerous to dive. The custom-built rigs, some barely seaworthy, include an 80-foot barge run by the most successful gold dredger in Nome, Alaska, and a modified skiff that seats only two people.

programme.title: You Have Been Warned
programme.sub-title: The smartest and bravest people use science to take their skills to the next level, from using a vacuum cleaner as a didgeridoo to creating a mechanised super suit
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.sub-title: The manufacturing of Skippy peanut butter, aubergine Parmesan, Wonderful pistachios and chocolate bars filled with tortilla chips and candy
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Houdini's Last Secrets

programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? programme.title: Jamie's Comfort Food
